column1: # What each government's own website says about a program reading it. BUILD_PLAN.md section 6.
# One row per site. Read by research passes on the date shown. The vendor's terms are a
# result   own_pages_silent     terms-like pages were read and none speaks of automated access
#          links_vendor_terms   the site itself links the vendor's terms
#          no_terms_found       no terms-like page could be found or read
#          reuse_needs_consent  the site's terms bar copying or reusing its content without the
#                               government's written consent. Held out until the owner decides
#          could_not_read       the site did not load for the reader
#          bars_automated_access  the site's own terms bar robots or data gathering tools
#          robots_bar           a robots file on the site
